section_name: The controls framework is the blueprint for how a company protects its
body:
data and infrastructure.

View the Full Controls Framework

![](assets/chevron_right.svg)

View the Framework Based on Your Role

![](assets/chevron_right.svg)

View the Framework by Domain

![](assets/chevron_right.svg)

View Compliance Framework Mappings

![](assets/chevron_right.svg)

Five core capabilities - cybersecurity, privacy, fraud prevention, crisis
management, and physical security - are represented in these unified controls
framework.

The NIST CSF version 1.1 and NIST PF were selected as the foundation for the
security controls framework because it supports a comprehensive, defense-in-
depth approach to security and privacy. Its flexible, risk-based structure can
also be tailored to meet a company's specific needs.

This framework enables an organization to:
Find risks and determine the severity
Ensure your assets are prepared for potential attackers
When a vulnerability is found, act on it
Assess what happened to help prevent future incidents

section_name: How to Use the Controls Framework
body:
**1.**

**Select the Controls and Technical Requirements that work best for your
organization.** Keep in mind that the Controls and Technical Requirements
should be tailored to represent the current point in time of your organization
and not be inspirational.



**2.**

**Customize the Technical Requirements.** Partner with your Security or
Technology team to fill in the "[INSERT] sections" for certain technical
requirements.



**3.**

**Establish governance processes to ensure you are following the controls.**
Remember, a governance process should result in escalations if what is
prescribed is not met.



**4.**

**Keep the Controls and Technical Requirements up-to-date.** Your organization
should establish a cadence for reviewing and updating to reflect the ongoing
maturity of your organization.

[Click here](https://github.com/Equifax-Public/SecurityControlsFramework) to
view the framework on GitHub, where you can provide feedback and ask
questions.
